headings: FACETED METAL WATERING CAN | STUDIO MARY LENNOX

jsonld_raw.name: FACETED METAL WATERING CAN | STUDIO MARY LENNOX
jsonld_raw.description:
Watering can crafted from stainless steel. Features a faceted design with an octagonal polygonal body, a top lid with an integrated handle, a long-neck cylindrical side spout for precise watering, and a side cylindrical handle. Ideal for the maintenance and care of floral arrangements.

Studio Mary Lennox is a botanical creative studio founded by Ruby Barber, based in Berlin with international reach. Specializing in floral styling, botanical design, and creative direction, the studio is renowned for its immersive botanical concepts, artistic direction, and large-scale installations.
